qualification: macOS 27 / Xcode 27 / Swift 6.4; Apple event order is a bounded observation, not a claim about all OS releases.

anyview-same-type.reason: The same erased concrete type retains its count across a parent input change.

anyview-type-change.reason: Replacing the erased concrete type tears down the old leaf and initializes the new leaf; SwiftTUI retains its tested teardown-first ordering.

binding-projection.reason: The projected count becomes 3 while sibling value 7 is preserved.

equal-value-write.reason: Writing the current value emits no onChange event and retains value 0.

explicit-identity-reset.reason: State resets to zero; SwiftTUI preserves its tested disappearance-before-appearance commit order, unlike this Apple observation.

state-batching.reason: Two synchronous writes before the next host update publish only the final observed value 2.
